features.statement: Hero image runs full viewport width, edge to edge, rather than sitting inside a contained content box.
Hero headline is set in very large type that fills roughly half the hero width.
Search form sits in a dark navy band attached directly to the bottom of the hero.
Button labels use sentence or title case instead of all-caps uppercase.
Typography uses a single system sans-serif family (Helvetica Neue) instead of a proprietary multi-weight brand font.
Section headings are bold (700) and colored dark navy rather than near-black.
Cards are left-aligned with title-case navy titles and gray body text, not centered uppercase titles.
Card and sub-card titles use proper heading tags (h3 under h2), giving a clean hierarchical heading outline.
Content column is wide, with cards and images spanning about 1080px of a 1440px viewport.
Card call-to-action buttons are small inline pill buttons below the text, and the centered section CTA is also a pill.
Links are bold navy without underline.
Content sections render fully, including a grid of employee profile cards with photo, name, and role/location lines.
A career-path timeline is shown as cyan dots on a vertical line with dated, located entries.
Carousel pagination uses numbered circular buttons rather than small dot indicators.
Testimonial is shown as a photo beside a large pull-quote with a dash-prefixed attribution line.
Photo gallery tiles are large, fill the column with small gaps, and sit on a pale-blue band.
Page uses alternating background bands: white, pale blue, and dark navy, instead of dominant brand-blue backgrounds.
Footer is a compact dark navy band with a heading and small social icons and minimal legal text.
Cards are wrapped in article elements and the DOM is lean, hand-written, with few divs, scripts and classes.
Layout mixes CSS grid with flexbox.
Intro paragraphs are constrained to a narrower reading measure of roughly 770px.
Form fields have visible label elements, and images carry descriptive alt text.
Wide portrait photos are cropped to small squares with object-fit, sometimes cutting off subjects.
Header is minimal, with only a small logo at the far left and no navigation links.
Page uses fewer box shadows and no gradients or backdrop blur, giving a flat look.
